help.badspell.impulse: Starts the spell when cast. Returns an event, not energy. Connect it to Activate and target runes.
help.badspell.activate: Executes the connected effect on its trigger. Must be the output of a castable spell. Checks budget and pays FL/FK before changing the world.
help.badspell.self: Returns you as an entity. Connect directly to Heal. For light or areas, use Entity position first. Self is not a position!
help.badspell.entity_position: Converts an entity to its current block position. Example: Self → Entity position → Circle → Shield.
help.badspell.entity_health: Reads the connected entity’s health from the local server context. 20 health points equal ten hearts.
help.badspell.has_target: True when a living entity is detected under the crosshair. Combine with If to safely skip a branch with no target.
help.badspell.target_entity: Returns the first living entity under the crosshair, up to twelve blocks away. Walls block detection. No target rejects the spell without spending energy.
help.badspell.target_entity_id: Looks up a UUID among locally observed entities. Field sight displays UUIDs. Does not search remotely or load chunks.
help.badspell.target_position: Returns the target point in front of the viewed block face, or at the end of the look range. Use for light and areas.
help.badspell.target_block: Returns the viewed block itself, rather than the point in front. Use for seals and local machine links.
help.badspell.position: A fixed position with dimension and X Y Z. These coordinates do not move with the player.
help.badspell.offset: Offsets a position by a vector. 1000 vector units equal one block. Example: (0,1000,0) moves the point one block up.
help.badspell.vector: Direction and magnitude as X Y Z in thousandths of a block. Used by Push and Offset. Y is up; Z is south.
help.badspell.direction: Returns your look direction as a normalized vector. Connected to Push, it moves the target away from you.
help.badspell.point: Converts a position to a region containing exactly one block cell. Does not create an effect on its own.
help.badspell.circle: A filled horizontal circle around the position. Radius is in blocks. Requires an effect to do anything.
help.badspell.sphere: A filled sphere around the position, radius up to six blocks. For light, all affected cells must be empty.
help.badspell.ray: A straight region from a position along a direction, up to 16 blocks. Requires BOTH position and vector.
help.badspell.path: Creates up to 16 evenly spaced waypoints between start and end. Light moves along these points instead of lighting them all permanently.
help.badspell.path_start: Starts a path at a position. Use Append path to add more waypoints.
help.badspell.path_append: Appends a position to a path. Maximum 16 waypoints, all in the same dimension.
help.badspell.light: Creates temporary real block light in the region. Strength 1–8; duration in ticks. Every target cell must be air. 20 ticks = 1 second.
help.badspell.heat: Creates a finite heat field. Damages permitted entities in the region once per second. Does not set blocks on fire.
help.badspell.cold: Creates a finite cold field. Freezes permitted entities, slows them and extinguishes their fire.
help.badspell.shield: Creates a finite shield field. Removes incoming projectiles in the region and pushes other entities back.
help.badspell.heal: Grants regeneration to an injured entity. Does not work at full health, during regeneration or during the healing cooldown. Self is a valid target.
help.badspell.push: Moves a permitted entity using the connected vector. Strength multiplies the vector; excessive speeds and very powerful entities are rejected.
help.badspell.see: Displays an entity’s name, health and UUID. Does not deal damage.
help.badspell.combine: Combines up to eight effects in one activation. Costs are added and all targets checked first. One rejected part prevents the entire cast without energy cost. Supports combat, light and empty effects; not transfers.
help.badspell.if: Selects exactly one branch using a true/false condition: If true or Otherwise. The other branch is not evaluated. All three inputs must be connected.
help.badspell.equal: Compares two values of the same type. Returns true or false; entities are compared by UUID.
help.badspell.greater: Returns true when number A is greater than number B. Example: 12 > Health detects fewer than six hearts.
help.badspell.number: A constant whole number. Used by comparisons and arithmetic.
help.badspell.boolean: A constant true/false value. Used by conditions and logic.
help.badspell.and: True when both conditions are true.
help.badspell.or: True when at least one condition is true.
help.badspell.add: Adds number A and number B. Overflow rejects the spell.
help.badspell.subtract: Subtracts number B from number A.
help.badspell.multiply: Multiplies number A by number B.
help.badspell.delay: Delays the trigger by the given number of ticks. No effect energy is spent before it is due.
help.badspell.interval: Repeats the spell every 20–1200 ticks. Each execution is checked and paid again, plus one sensor FL per second of interval. Without Limit, the job continues.
help.badspell.limit: Limits an event to 1–64 successful executions. Insufficient energy does not consume an execution.
help.badspell.abort: Marks an event as cancelled. An Activate output connected to it does nothing.
help.badspell.none: An intentionally empty effect, useful for Otherwise branches. No effect cost; periodic sensing still costs FL.
help.badspell.check: Passes an effect through unchanged. Actual validation happens before Activate. Check does not produce a boolean.
help.badspell.return: Returns a value from a reusable subformula. A castable main formula still needs Activate as its output.
help.badspell.input: Names a typed subformula input. It becomes a port when called as a module; outside a call the configured default is used.
help.badspell.sign: Creates a stable text signature from position and frequency 1–4. Does not store energy or bind an entity.
help.badspell.sign_entity: Creates a text signature from entity UUID and frequency. The signature alone does not create an effect.
help.badspell.measure: Reads available FL charge from your viewed station. Only the position observed in the context can be measured.
help.badspell.bind: Stores a temporary local link between two positions, up to 16 blocks. Transport is performed separately using Transfer.
help.badspell.transfer: Transfers up to 16 items between permitted local inventories. No partial transfer if the destination is full.
help.badspell.transfer_energy: Transfers a limited amount of FL between your local stations. Both stations require a field cell.
help.badspell.seal: Temporarily seals a block for its owner, or removes the owner’s seal. Cannot create permanent locks on others’ blocks.
help.badspell.environment_rain: 1 if raining at the observed point, otherwise 0.
help.badspell.environment_sky: 1 if the observed point can see the sky, otherwise 0.
help.badspell.environment_health: Your health, not the viewed entity’s health. Use Entity health for that.
help.badspell.environment_field: FL charge of your viewed station.
help.badspell.environment_stability: Stability of the current device or rune field.
help.badspell.environment_biome: Deterministic numeric identifier of the observed biome.

codex.badspell.start.title: First spell
codex.badspell.start.body:
1. Carry a formula book, glove and charged field cell.

2. Open the book. Create a Light template in the Library, or use the starter Light spark.

3. Save → To glove. Aim at empty air in front of a block and right-click with the glove.

Light is clearer at night. FL is stored in cells; FK recovers after a casting pause. Creating a template uses writing points.
codex.badspell.start.image: Colored sockets show the data type.
codex.badspell.editor.title: Wiring
codex.badspell.editor.body:
1. Click + Rune. Search by effect, data type or port. Input and output filters narrow the results.

2. Click an open node input. The picker shows only compatible outputs; inserting a rune connects it automatically.

3. For existing nodes: click the output on the right, then a matching input on the left. Right-click an input to disconnect.

4. Select a node and edit values on the left. Wheel over canvas zooms; middle mouse pans. Scroll over Details to reveal more parameters. ? explains the rune.

Set Activate as output. Save before exporting.
codex.badspell.editor.image: Colored sockets show the data type.
codex.badspell.targets.title: Targets
codex.badspell.targets.body:
Self returns an ENTITY. Heal and Push expect entities. Light, Heat, Cold and Shield expect a REGION.

For a field around you: Self → Entity position → Circle → Shield. Then connect Shield to Activate.

For a creature: Impulse → Target entity. Entity position converts the target into a location for a cold field.

Walls block targeting. Targets beyond twelve blocks are not detected. Other players are protected without consent.

Healing at full health intentionally does nothing and costs nothing. The Self light template demonstrates conversion.
codex.badspell.targets.image: Colored sockets show the data type.
codex.badspell.combine.title: Combinations
codex.badspell.combine.body:
Frost push connects real component effects:

1. Target entity → Entity position → Point → Cold.

2. The same Target entity and Look direction → Push.

3. Cold and Push → Combine effects → Activate.

Target present controls an If node. With no target it chooses Empty; the invalid target branch is never evaluated.

Combine adds costs. Both effects are checked first. If one is invalid, nothing runs and no energy is spent. Up to eight effects; transfers cannot be combined.
codex.badspell.combine.image: Colored sockets show the data type.
codex.badspell.logic.title: Conditions
codex.badspell.logic.body:
Adaptive ward chooses based on your health:

Self → Entity health. A Number 12 and health feed Greater: 12 > Health.

True: Self → Heal. False: Self → Entity position → Circle → Shield.

Both effects and the condition feed If effect; its output feeds Activate. Only the chosen branch is evaluated and paid.

Modules: save your own formula with named inputs and a Return, then insert it as a module from the Library. The call stores an immutable copy.
codex.badspell.logic.image: Colored sockets show the data type.
codex.badspell.energy.title: Energy
codex.badspell.energy.body:
FL pays for world effects. Field cells hold 100/300/600 FL; multiple inventory cells are used together. FK is personal focus.

20 ticks = one second. Delay shifts an event. Interval repeats the formula; Limit sets the number of successful executions.

Every repeat is validated and paid again. Insufficient energy pauses it without consuming a limited execution.

Shift-right-click with the glove cancels your scheduled spells. Up to four concurrent jobs are allowed. Sensor intervals cost extra FL.
codex.badspell.energy.image: Colored sockets show the data type.
codex.badspell.stations.title: Stations
codex.badspell.stations.body:
Place ingredients in the left work area. Results appear on the right. The cell adapter and field cell go in the two marked power slots at the bottom center.

A station’s ? opens its actual processing recipes, showing ingredient icons, FL and duration. Switch station at the top of the recipe guide.

Grinder: crystals and dust. Smelter: ingots and alloys. Alchemy table: solutions and essences. Press: blank plates. Engraving station: insert formula book and blank plate; the book is retained.

Rune holder: inscribed plate in the upper single slot, power below. Redstone activates it. The holder executes all registered effects. It aims forward; Origin returns its clear output above the device. Start/Stop control the job. Devices pay FL, not FK.

Field crystal: point its tip towards the consumer. Right-click with an empty hand to rotate. On demand, up to 80 FL/s travels through at most 16 crystals between your stations. Only cells store energy; both endpoints require adapters. Moon salt also needs quartz as a crystallization seed.
codex.badspell.stations.image: Colored sockets show the data type.
codex.badspell.tools.title: Tools
codex.badspell.tools.body:
Glove: Shift-wheel cycles 4/8/12 slots. A saved formula is exported from the book as an independent copy.

Chisel: open a solid block face, place and connect up to 16 runes. Saving consumes durability; cancelling does not. Removing the block destroys the engraving.

Resonance fork: right-click air to switch diagnosis/activation, then click your engraving.

Compass: Shift-right-click binds a location. Normal right-click shows direction and signal.

Monocle: wear in the head slot; M cycles Off/Normal/Intense. Scans cost FK. G opens this Codex anytime.
codex.badspell.tools.image: Colored sockets show the data type.
codex.badspell.problems.title: Troubleshooting
codex.badspell.problems.body:
No target: move closer and aim at the creature’s body. Use Target present + If for safe optional targeting.

Self does not fit: an entity is not a location! Entity position converts it. Point or Circle turns it into a region.

Healing: only injured targets without ongoing regeneration. Rejected casts do not spend energy.

No light: every affected cell must be air. A sphere intersecting the ground is invalid. Start with Point light.

Red ports: types or required connections are wrong. Validate identifies the node and port. Search by input/output.

Station stopped: read the status below. Check adapter, charge, ingredients and output space.
